$comment: Auto-fill rules for the daily Lazada KAF (key attribute fill) task. A rule matches a Lazada TH listing by shop (brand_id) + attribute key + optional title regex / category, and writes a fixed value. Only values listed here, or facts confirmed on the brand's official website with the source URL logged, may be written automatically. Edit via pull request; the daily task reads this file from the repo.

rules.reason: Plain soy-based sauces with no flavour variant; the other Lazada options describe different products.
Official TH site states a 2-year guarantee for Mini Me and Genio S Plus. Genio S Basic / Touch pending KAM confirmation.
Corded mains tools per Remington UK product pages.
Region of Origin = Mainland China on the same SKU's Remington Shopee TH listing.
rules.blocked_by: TISI qualification (BIZ_CHECK_QUALIFICATION_CODE_REQUIRED) until uploaded in Seller Center

rules.reason: Warranty Duration = 24 Months on the same SKU's Remington Shopee TH listing and in the Lazada description.
rules.blocked_by: TISI qualification (BIZ_CHECK_QUALIFICATION_CODE_REQUIRED) until uploaded in Seller Center

rules.reason: Guess titles always carry the product code (e.g. GW0873L2, M6YB07W2688, TG232501); the Model attribute is that code.

rules.title_regex: แขนสั้น|แขนยาว
rules.reason: Title states short/long sleeve, which is Lazada's 'Regular' sleeve type (not sleeveless, raglan, roll-up or arm sleeve).
Region of Origin on the same SKU's Etude House Shopee TH listing (3535607181).
Lazada description states ผลิตในประเทศฝรั่งเศส (made in France).

rule_semantics: A rule applies when brand_id matches (number or list), the attribute key matches, item_id (if given) matches, category_id (if given) matches, and title_regex (if given) matches the title. The written value is `value`, or for value_source.type=title_regex the regex match (group) from the title; no match = rule does not apply. A rule with blocked_by is reported, not written.

never_auto_fill.reason: Product dimensions must come from the brand; the CREA flow tool also cannot send the unit Lazada requires (BIZ_CHECK_MEASURE_UNIT_INVALID).
Electrical ratings only from the brand's spec sheet or manual.
Compliance field: only copy from the same SKU's Shopee listing or brand document, never infer.

brand_site_facts.$comment: Daily task may fill a gap from the brand's OFFICIAL website only (not retailers), logging the URL in the change row. Allowed domains per brand.
